name: derived-projection-buffer
body: The coordinator's derived-projection buffer: accumulate mutation records during the session and flush them into `db.lbug` in a single batched re-ingest (or bounded flushes) at session end, amortizing the DB open/parse across N mutations. Buffers only the derived projection — durable node files and their per-mutation commits are written directly as today; durable writes are never buffered without a WAL. (Not yet built — planned code.)
